title: Full Stack Engineer (Automation & AI Systems)
overview: Building automation and AI-driven workflow systems for sales, HR, and CRM use-cases using n8n, LangChain, and custom backend services.

responsibilities.title: Workflow Orchestration (n8n + Custom Backend)
responsibilities.description: Designed and deployed workflow pipelines using n8n with custom Node.js services for state management, retries, and long-running task handling.

responsibilities.title: AI Agent & LLM Integration
responsibilities.description: Built LLM-powered workflows using LangChain/LangGraph for tasks like lead enrichment, content generation, and decision support.

responsibilities.title: System Integration
responsibilities.description: Integrated multiple third-party APIs (CRMs, email, scraping tools) and internal services into unified automation pipelines.

responsibilities.title: Production Debugging
responsibilities.description: Handled failures across distributed workflows, including API timeouts, inconsistent states, and partial execution issues.

impact: Reduced manual intervention in repetitive workflows across sales and CRM operations.
achievements: Built automation workflows handling hundreds to thousands of executions per day across multiple clients
Implemented retry and fallback mechanisms to handle unreliable third-party APIs
Integrated 8–12 external services including CRMs, email providers, and scraping pipelines
Developed AI-assisted workflows for content generation and lead qualification
keyHighlights: Hybrid architecture combining no-code (n8n) with custom backend services
Use of LangChain/LangGraph for structured AI workflows
Handling of long-running and failure-prone workflows

challenges.title: Unreliable External APIs
challenges.solution: Implemented retry strategies with backoff and partial state recovery to prevent workflow failure cascades.

challenges.title: State Management in n8n
challenges.solution: Used external persistence layers and custom services to track workflow progress beyond n8n’s default capabilities.

challenges.title: LLM Output Reliability
challenges.solution: Added validation layers and structured prompting to reduce hallucinations and inconsistent outputs.

learnings: Practical limitations of no-code tools at scale
Designing hybrid systems combining orchestration tools and backend services
Failure handling in distributed, API-heavy workflows
Trade-offs in using LLMs in production systems
